script: let L = ""; for v in D { L += ", " + v; }
let EXT = "mix(pick(" + K + L + "), pick(min(" + K + "+1,47)" + L + "), smoothstep(0.0,1.0,fract(" + YR + ")))";
let out = [];
out.push(#{ id: "ice", type: "shader", src: "ice.glsl", uniforms: #{ yr: "=" + YR, ghost: "=clamp((T-5.2)/1.2,0,1)" } });
let x0 = 1130.0; let pitch = 15.6; let base = 925.0; let k = 40.0;
out.push(#{ draw: [ #{ line: [x0 - 14.0, base - 7.05*k, x0 + 47.0*pitch + 14.0, base - 7.05*k], stroke: "#FFDCB3", width: 1.5, opacity: 0.55 } ], opacity: "=clamp((T-5.2)/1.2,0,1)" });

out.push(#{ text: "1979 level", font: "IBM Plex Mono", size: 20, color: "#FFDCB3", x: x0 + 47.0*pitch + 10.0, y: base - 7.05*k - 18.0, anchor: "right", align: "right", width: 300, opacity: "=clamp((T-5.2)/1.2,0,1)" });
for j in 0..48 {
let y = 1979 + j; let hgt = D[j] * k;
let col = if y == 2012 { "#FF7A45" } else { "#9DB8CA" };
out.push(#{ shape: "rect", width: 9, height: hgt, anchor: "bottom", scaleY: "=" + grow, x: x0 + j * pitch, y: base, fill: "=floor(" + YR + ")==" + y + " ? #FFFFFF : " + col });
out.push(#{ text: "1979", font: "IBM Plex Mono", size: 20, color: "#8FA9BA", x: x0 - 4.0, y: base + 28.0, anchor: "left" });
out.push(#{ text: "2026", font: "IBM Plex Mono", size: 20, color: "#8FA9BA", x: x0 + 47.0*pitch + 4.0, y: base + 28.0, anchor: "right", opacity: "=" + YR + ">=2025.5?1:0.35" });

out.push(#{ text: "{value:0}", value: "=floor(" + YR + ")", font: "IBM Plex Mono", weight: 300, size: "21vh", color: "#EEF3F6", x: x0 - 10.0, y: 440, anchor: "left", align: "left", width: 760, letterSpacing: "-0.04em" });

for j in 0..48 { let y = 1979 + j; out.push(#{ text: if D[j] * 100.0 % 10.0 == 0.0 { "" + D[j] + "0" } else { "" + D[j] }, opacity: "=floor(" + YR + ")==" + y + "?1:0", font: "IBM Plex Mono", size: "6vh", color: "=floor(" + YR + ")==2012 ? #FF7A45 : #EEF3F6", x: x0 - 4.0, y: 575, anchor: "left", align: "left", width: 200 }); }
out.push(#{ text: "million km² of ice, September", font: "Newsreader", italic: true, size: "3vh", color: "#8FA9BA", x: x0 + 170.0, y: 581, anchor: "left", align: "left", width: 520 });
out

layers.text: Every September, the Arctic Ocean’s floating ice shrinks to its smallest.
The dashed line is where its edge was in *1979*.
2012: the smallest on record. Half of 1979.
Since 2007, every September has been smaller than every one before it.
Sea ice extent from satellite, NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4

script: let x0 = 150.0; let pitch = 29.0; let base = 900.0; let k = 64.0; let bw = 19.0;
let out = [];
for j in 0..48 {
let y = 1979 + j; let hgt = D[j] * k;
let col = if y == 2012 { "#FF7A45" } else if j < 10 || j >= 38 { "#EEF3F6" } else { "#7F9CB0" };

out.push(#{ shape: "rect", width: bw, height: hgt, x: x0 + j * pitch, y: base, fill: col, anchor: "bottom", animate: [ #{ from: #{ scaleY: 0 }, to: #{ scaleY: 1 }, at: 0.15 + j * 0.022, duration: 0.7, ease: "outExpo" } ] });
let xa = x0 - bw; let xb = x0 + 9.0 * pitch + bw; let xc = x0 + 38.0 * pitch - bw; let xd = x0 + 47.0 * pitch + bw;

out.push(#{ draw: [ #{ line: [xa, base - m1*k, xd + 40.0, base - m1*k], stroke: "#FFDCB3", width: 2 }, #{ line: [xc - 10.0, base - m2*k, xd + 40.0, base - m2*k], stroke: "#FFDCB3", width: 2 }, #{ line: [xd + 40.0, base - m1*k, xd + 40.0, base - m2*k], stroke: "#FF7A45", width: 3 } ], enter: "draw", start: 1.9 });
out.push(#{ text: "−36%", font: "IBM Plex Mono", weight: 500, size: "9vh", color: "#FF7A45", x: xd + 64.0, y: base - (m1 + m2) / 2.0 * k, anchor: "left", start: 2.6, enter: "mask by line up" });
out.push(#{ text: "1979–88 avg  " + m1, font: "IBM Plex Mono", size: 20, color: "#FFDCB3", x: xd + 64.0, y: base - m1*k - 4.0, anchor: "left", start: 2.2, enter: "fade" });
out.push(#{ text: "2017–26 avg  " + m2, font: "IBM Plex Mono", size: 20, color: "#FFDCB3", x: xd + 64.0, y: base - m2*k + 4.0, anchor: "left", start: 2.4, enter: "fade" });
let j = yy - 1979;
out.push(#{ text: "" + yy, font: "IBM Plex Mono", size: 20, color: if yy == 2012 { "#FF9A70" } else { "#8FA9BA" }, x: x0 + j * pitch, y: base + 30.0, start: 0.6, enter: "fade" });
out
